atoms.1: Prozac is also known as fluoxetine.
atoms.2: Prozac is a selective serotonin reuptake inhibitor (SSRI).
atoms.3: It is essential to discontinue Prozac under the guidance of a healthcare professional.
atoms.4: Abruptly stopping Prozac can lead to withdrawal symptoms.
atoms.5: Withdrawal symptoms of Prozac include dizziness.
atoms.6: Withdrawal symptoms of Prozac include headache.
atoms.7: Withdrawal symptoms of Prozac include nausea.
atoms.8: Withdrawal symptoms of Prozac include fatigue.
atoms.9: Withdrawal symptoms of Prozac include irritability.
atoms.10: A gradual tapering of the Prozac dose is often recommended to minimize the risk of withdrawal symptoms.
atoms.11: The optimal tapering schedule for Prozac is not well established.
atoms.12: A commonly recommended approach is to reduce the Prozac dose by 20-30% every 2-4 weeks.
atoms.13: The Prozac dose reduction can be repeated until the dose is discontinued.
atoms.14: The duration and rate of tapering Prozac may need to be adjusted based on individual factors.
atoms.15: Individual factors include the dosage of Prozac.
atoms.16: Individual factors include the duration of Prozac treatment.
atoms.17: Individual factors include the presence of Prozac withdrawal symptoms.
atoms.18: Some studies suggest that a slower tapering schedule may be more effective in reducing the risk of Prozac withdrawal symptoms.
atoms.19: A slower tapering schedule can be over a period of several weeks or months.
atoms.20: A study published in the Journal of Clinical Psychopharmacology found that patients who tapered off fluoxetine over a period of 6-12 weeks experienced fewer withdrawal symptoms.
atoms.21: Patients who tapered off fluoxetine over a period of 6-12 weeks experienced fewer withdrawal symptoms compared to those who tapered off more quickly.
atoms.22: Stopping Prozac suddenly can lead to more severe withdrawal symptoms.
atoms.23: Severe withdrawal symptoms of Prozac include seizures.
atoms.24: Severe withdrawal symptoms of Prozac include serotonin syndrome.
atoms.25: Serotonin syndrome is a potentially life-threatening condition.
atoms.26: It is essential to work closely with a healthcare professional to develop a tapering plan that minimizes the risk of Prozac withdrawal symptoms.
atoms.27: It is essential to work closely with a healthcare professional to ensure a safe discontinuation of Prozac.

snippets.output: Stopping Prozac (fluoxetine) suddenly can lead to serotonin syndrome, a potentially life-threatening condition.
snippets.notes: Atom 24 is expert-false (serotonin syndrome is caused by serotonergic excess, not SSRI withdrawal). Atom 25 (serotonin syndrome being life-threatening) is true on its own, but the merged claim attributing it to Prozac withdrawal is false.
